lead: A `Decided:` sentence's rationale clause can be false about the tree, and the decision still stands.
body: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/record.rs` gap 2 was answered "statically typed dumps already render the case", and nothing in the workspace builds a `nvs_render::Node::EnumCase` at all — the three renderings read the kind and no producer writes it. Build or strike the gap exactly as decided, and write the prose that replaces it from what you grepped, never from the rationale.
